test_replace_expr_datetime: test the dt.replace method on datetime columns using column references to replace year, month, day, hour, minute, second, and microsecond components
test_replace_expr_date: test the dt.replace method on date columns using column references to replace year, month, and day components
test_replace_int_datetime: test the dt.replace method on datetime columns with integer values to replace individual time components
test_replace_int_date: test the dt.replace method on date columns with integer values to replace year, month, and day components
test_replace_ambiguous: test the dt.replace method with ambiguous time handling during DST transitions using earliest, latest, null, and raise modes
test_replace_datetime_preserve_ns: test that dt.replace preserves nanosecond time unit when replacing datetime components from column references
test_replace_preserve_tu_and_tz: test that dt.replace preserves time unit and timezone across ms, us, and ns resolutions with various timezones
test_replace_date_invalid_components: test that dt.replace raises ComputeError for invalid date components like month 13 or day 32
test_replace_datetime_invalid_time_compo: test that dt.replace raises ComputeError for invalid time components like hour 25, minute 61, second 61, or microsecond 2000000
test_replace_unequal_length_22018: test that dt.replace raises ShapeError when replacement series length does not match the input series length
test_replace_broadcast_self: test that dt.replace broadcasts a scalar datetime against column expressions for all components
